rag_samples.question: My iPhone 15 Pro screen cracked from a drop. How much will it cost to fix under AppleCare+ vs out of warranty?
rag_samples.reference: Under AppleCare+, screen or back glass damage has a standardized $29.00 USD service deductible. Without AppleCare+ (out-of-warranty), screen replacement typically ranges between $199.00 and $379.00 USD depending on the model.
relevant_contexts: Official AppleCare+ Deductible Matrix: Screen or back glass damage (iPhone 12 through 16 Pro Max) is $29.00 USD under AppleCare+. Out-of-warranty screen repair costs between $199.00 and $379.00 USD.

Accidental damage from handling (ADH) covers unlimited incidents of accidental damage, subject to the per-incident service fee: $29 for screen/back glass damage and $99 for all other accidental damage.

rag_samples.question: I spilled water on my iPhone and it won't charge. Does warranty cover liquid damage, and what should I do right now?
rag_samples.reference: Liquid damage is not covered under Apple's 1-Year Limited Warranty, but is covered under AppleCare+ with a $99.00 USD accidental damage deductible. Immediately turn off the device, unplug all cables, tap gently against your hand with the connector facing down to remove excess liquid, and let it dry in an airflow area for 24-48 hours. Inspect the Liquid Contact Indicator (LCI) in the SIM tray slot. Do NOT use uncooked rice or hair dryers (Apple Support HT204104).
relevant_contexts: Apple Support HT204104: Liquid Exposure & Liquid Contact Indicator (LCI) Triage. Turn off device and disconnect all cables. Tap gently against hand connector-facing down. Dry in ventilated area 24-48 hours. Inspect LCI inside SIM tray with flashlight (turns pink/red if tripped). Do NOT put in rice or use heat guns.
Liquid damage is excluded from standard 1-Year Limited Warranty, but eligible for repair under AppleCare+ other accidental damage tier with a $99 service deductible.

rag_samples.question: My iPhone 14 battery health maximum capacity is showing 78%. Can I get a free battery replacement?
rag_samples.reference: Yes. If your device has active AppleCare+ coverage and the Battery Maximum Capacity has dropped below 80% (Settings > Battery > Battery Health & Charging), Apple provides a free ($0.00) battery replacement. Out-of-warranty battery service costs between $89.00 and $99.00 USD.
relevant_contexts: Official AppleCare+ Terms: Battery service is $0.00 (free) if maximum capacity drops below 80% of original capacity during active AppleCare+ coverage. Out-of-warranty battery replacement ranges from $89.00 to $99.00 USD.

Apple Support HT208387: Battery Health Diagnostics. If maximum capacity is under 80%, a diagnostic service message appears stating the battery condition is significantly degraded and requires servicing.

rag_samples.question: How do I force restart an iPhone 15 Pro if the screen is completely frozen and black?
rag_samples.reference: To force restart an iPhone 15 Pro (Apple Support HT201559): 1. Press and quickly release the Volume Up button. 2. Press and quickly release the Volume Down button. 3. Press and hold the Side button until the Apple logo appears (around 10–15 seconds), then release. Do not release when 'slide to power off' appears.
relevant_contexts: Apple Support HT201559: Force restart iPhone with Face ID: Press and quickly release Volume Up. Press and quickly release Volume Down. Press and hold the Side button until the Apple logo appears, then release.

rag_samples.question: My iPhone 15 Pro was stolen on the train. What are the requirements to file an AppleCare+ Theft and Loss claim?
rag_samples.reference: To file an AppleCare+ with Theft and Loss claim: 1. You must have active 'AppleCare+ with Theft and Loss' (standard AppleCare+ does not cover loss/theft). 2. 'Find My' must remain enabled on the device at the time of theft and throughout the entire claim process (do NOT remove it from your Apple ID). 3. Pay the $149.00 USD replacement deductible. 4. You may be required to provide a police report or government ID.
relevant_contexts: AppleCare+ with Theft and Loss terms: Requires Find My to be active on the device at the time it is lost or stolen and throughout the claim process. Deductible is $149.00 USD for iPhone. Removing the device from Find My or iCloud voids claim eligibility.
Standard AppleCare+ covers accidental damage only. Theft and Loss is an upgraded tier covering up to two incidents of theft or loss every 12 months.

rag_samples.question: I knocked a cup of coffee onto my MacBook Pro M3 keyboard. What is the deductible under AppleCare+?
rag_samples.reference: For liquid damage or logic board damage on a MacBook Pro under AppleCare+, the deductible is $299.00 USD under the 'mac_other_damage' tier. If out of warranty, repairs for logic board liquid corrosion typically range from $699.00 to $1,499.00 USD.
relevant_contexts: AppleCare+ for Mac Deductibles: Screen or external enclosure damage is $99.00 USD. Other accidental damage (including liquid spills, keyboard/top case, logic board damage) is $299.00 USD. Out-of-warranty repairs range from $699 to $1,499+ USD.
Genius Bar SOP: Liquid spills on Mac require mail-in depot inspection or logic board replacement. Ensure machine remains powered off.

rag_samples.question: My right AirPods Pro (2nd Gen) has no audio and will not connect. What are the troubleshooting steps?
rag_samples.reference: Follow Apple Support HT209463: 1. Place both AirPods in the charging case and charge for at least 30 minutes. 2. Clean the microphone and speaker mesh with a clean, dry lint-free cloth. 3. Reset AirPods: Go to Settings > Bluetooth, tap the Info icon next to AirPods, and tap 'Forget This Device'. Put AirPods in case with lid open, press and hold the setup button on the back for 15 seconds until the status light flashes amber then white. 4. Re-pair with device.
relevant_contexts: Apple Support HT209463: Reset AirPods and AirPods Pro. Put AirPods in case, close lid for 30s. Open lid, forget from Bluetooth, hold case setup button for 15 seconds until amber flashes then white. Reconnect.
If hardware audio failure persists after reset, individual AirPod replacement under AppleCare+ is $29.00 USD deductible, or $89.00 out of warranty.

rag_samples.question: What documentation is required to remove an Activation Lock if I forgot my Apple ID password?
rag_samples.reference: To request an Activation Lock removal support request with Apple (HT201365), you must provide official proof of purchase showing: 1. Device serial number or IMEI. 2. Original purchase date. 3. Authorized reseller or Apple Store name. 4. Product description. Handwritten receipts, eBay/second-hand seller slips, or device pawn slips are rejected. The device cannot be in Lost Mode.
relevant_contexts: Apple Support HT201365: How to remove Activation Lock. Proof of purchase must be original documentation from Apple or an Apple Authorized Reseller showing serial number, IMEI, purchase date, and store details. Devices flagged as Lost or Stolen cannot have Activation Lock removed.

rag_samples.question: How long does a Genius Bar iPhone screen repair usually take vs a depot mail-in repair?
rag_samples.reference: Same-day service is typically available for iPhone screen and battery repairs at an Apple Store Genius Bar (typically 2 to 4 hours depending on parts availability). Mail-in depot repairs or complex component repairs (e.g. Mac logic boards, structural damage) typically take 3 to 5 business days.
relevant_contexts: Genius Bar Turnaround Standards: Same-day screen and battery replacements completed in store within 2-4 hours. Mail-in depot repairs via Apple Repair Center average 3-5 business days including transit.

rag_samples.question: What is Express Replacement Service (ERS) under AppleCare+ and how does it work?
rag_samples.reference: Express Replacement Service (ERS) is an AppleCare+ benefit where Apple ships a replacement device immediately before you send back your damaged device. Apple places a temporary credit card authorization hold for the full replacement value of the device, which is released once Apple receives and inspects your original damaged unit within 10 business days.
relevant_contexts: Express Replacement Service (ERS) terms: Available exclusively to active AppleCare+ subscribers. Apple ships replacement within 24-48 hours with packaging to return defective unit. Temporary card hold covers full retail value until original device is received within 10 business days.

rag_samples.question: How do I boot an Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3) Mac into Safe Mode to troubleshoot kernel panics?
rag_samples.reference: For Apple Silicon Macs (Apple Support HT201262): 1. Shut down your Mac completely. 2. Press and hold the power button until 'Loading startup options' appears on screen. 3. Select your startup disk (e.g., Macintosh HD). 4. Press and hold the Shift key, then click 'Continue in Safe Mode'. 5. Log in. The words 'Safe Boot' will appear in the menu bar.
relevant_contexts: Apple Support HT201262: Start up your Mac in Safe Mode. For Apple Silicon: Shut down Mac. Press and hold power button until 'Loading startup options' appears. Select volume, hold Shift key, click Continue in Safe Mode.

rag_samples.question: What evidence do I need to prepare before filing an AppleCare incident claim for cracked back glass?
rag_samples.reference: To prepare your AppleCare claim: 1. Have your 12-character Device Serial Number or IMEI ready (Settings > General > About). 2. Clear photos of the cracked back glass showing no severe battery bulging or missing fragments. 3. Verified Find My status and Apple ID email. 4. Completed iCloud or local Mac backup before handing in the device.
relevant_contexts: AppleCare Claim Intake Engine: Checklist for submission requires serial number verification, photographic damage evidence, Find My verification, and customer backup confirmation before service appointment.

rag_samples.question: Does AppleCare+ have a limit on how many accidental damage repairs I can claim each year?
rag_samples.reference: No. AppleCare+ plans now offer unlimited incidents of accidental damage protection (ADH) during the active coverage period. Each incident is subject to the applicable service fee ($29 for screen/back glass, $99 for other damage). Theft and loss coverage remains limited to up to two incidents every 12 months.
relevant_contexts: AppleCare+ Policy Update: AppleCare+ now includes unlimited incidents of accidental damage from handling, each subject to applicable service fees. Theft and loss claims remain capped at up to 2 incidents per 12-month period.

rag_samples.question: My Apple Watch Series 9 screen is not responding to touch. How do I force restart it?
rag_samples.reference: To force restart an Apple Watch (Apple Support HT204510): Press and hold both the Side button and the Digital Crown simultaneously for at least 10 seconds. Release both buttons when the Apple logo appears. Note: Never force restart during a watchOS update.
relevant_contexts: Apple Support HT204510: Restart Apple Watch. To force restart, hold both the side button and Digital Crown for at least 10 seconds until the Apple logo appears. Do not force restart while Apple Watch is updating watchOS.

rag_samples.question: What happens if a technician finds unauthorized third-party parts or third-party batteries inside my iPhone during service?
rag_samples.reference: Apple Authorized Service Providers inspect internal components. While genuine repair history is preferred, presence of non-genuine displays or batteries does not automatically disqualify out-of-warranty service or AppleCare+ repairs, provided the third-party part did not cause catastrophic damage. However, if third-party modifications make the unit unsafe (e.g., punctured non-genuine battery or glued chassis), service may be declined.
relevant_contexts: Apple Service Policy: Non-genuine battery or display presence does not automatically void out-of-warranty repairs or AppleCare+ service eligibility, provided safety standards are met and the issue is not caused by unauthorized tampering.
